speaker: Doctor
text: The urinalysis shows bacteria-free leukocyturia, which points toward an interstitial process rather than a standard bacterial infection. The presence of binucleated eosinophilic cells in the cytospin is highly suggestive of eosinophils. Given your recent antibiotic use for sinusitis, have you noticed any new rash, itching, or difficulty breathing since starting the medication?

text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The persistence of fever and flank pain after your sinusitis improved, combined with urine findings showing eosinophils and a negative bacterial culture, strongly suggests an allergic reaction to the antibiotics you took. Has the antibiotic course been completed, and have you noticed any skin rash or joint pain recently?

Given the history of antibiotic treatment, flank pain, fever, and urine findings of eosinophils with a negative bacterial culture, do you have a known history of allergies or asthma?
